verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Browser Use exposing itself as an MCP *server* that other clients like Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf connect to (docs-12, probe-3, probe-rt-2) — the opposite direction from this story, which asks whether Browser Use itself can act as an MCP client consuming external MCP servers' tools. No evidence shows Browser Use ingesting or calling tools from third-party MCP servers.
